explanationMd:
Test whether each proposed statement can be added consistently to the rules. "Ritual must precede Origins." is incompatible with every permitted order. The alternative statements each have a complete valid example, given in their feedback. To check impossibility, enumerate placements for the most restricted item or block, then remove every case breaking a rule.

Complete permitted orders (each arrow advances one position):
- Origins → Trade → Ritual → Legacy → Change
- Origins → Trade → Legacy → Ritual → Change
- Origins → Change → Ritual → Legacy → Trade
- Origins → Change → Legacy → Ritual → Trade
- Trade → Origins → Legacy → Change → Ritual
- Change → Origins → Legacy → Trade → Ritual
